The failure of France and the United Kingdom to alert other Allies before launching, together with Israel, their failed military operation to seize control of the Suez Canal and prevent its nationalisation by Egypt, gave impetus to the recommendations of an advisory group known as ‘The Three Wise Men,’ that called for strengthening Allied political consultations.3
